cds.title: Tiffin University Common Data Set 2023-2024 (PDF; newest year published on its Institutional Research page)

stats.notes: CDS C1 (fall 2023): applicants, admits and enrollees are the sums of the men/women/another-gender rows (4,785 / 3,817 / 504). The residency table shows 4,724 / 3,783 / 504 in total, with International 570 applied, 206 admitted, 17 enrolled (about 36% of international applicants admitted versus about 80% overall), In-state 2,197 / 1,911 / 322 and Out-of-state 1,957 / 1,666 / 165; the residency totals are slightly below the C1 totals, so in-state and out-of-state counts are left null. SAT submitted by 21% (108) and ACT by 52% (262) of enrolled first-years (C9). C11 All-enrolled GPA ranges; 1.5% of students were below 1.0. College Navigator for fall 2024 shows 5,949 applicants and about 80% admitted. Undergraduate enrollment 2,666 and nonresident count 115 are the B1 Total Undergraduates column (fall 2023); the C7 factor checkboxes could not be read from the PDF, so factors are omitted.
